en: Judges 8

p.src: 1  The men of Ephraim said to him, “Why have you treated us this way, that you didn’t call us when you went to fight with Midian?” They rebuked him sharply.

ja: ばなかったのか。どうしてこのような扱いをしたのか。」
en: The men of Ephraim said to him, “Why have you treated us this way, that you didn’t call us when you went to fight with Midian?” They rebuked him sharply.

p.src: 2  He said to them, “What have I now done in comparison with you? Isn’t the gleaning of the grapes of Ephraim better than the vintage of Abiezer?

ja: がしたことは、あなたがたに
べれば何だろうか。エフライムのぶどうの落ち穂拾いは、アビエゼルのぶどうの収穫にまさるではないか。

p.src: 3  God has delivered into your hand the princes of Midian, Oreb and Zeeb! What was I able to do in comparison with you?” Then their anger was abated toward him when he had said that.
